title: Book Two · Chapter 140: Thirteen at the Table
story:
Another winter passes. Spring rain fills the street drains, and the green door needs a hard push on damp mornings. Ronan turns thirteen during a week of bright afternoons.

He measures himself against Dad beside the wall.

“Still some way,” Dad says.

“Not much.”

Dad raises his heels. Mum sees him at once.

“Both feet down.”

Ronan laughs and checks again. He is taller than last year, but Dad still wins.

His birthday meal is at home. Mum planned her work this week. Today she has finished early. Dad comes back on time. There is a small dish of meat, green vegetables, and a cake with fruit.

Jun cannot come. He has a family visit. Leo brings a note from him. Jun can meet for a game next week. Mei comes for half an hour and brings a drawing of Dad on very long toes.

Dad holds the card at arm's length.

“Very accurate.”

“Very tall,” Ronan says.

Leo asks if the toes count in the family measurement. Mum says no. Mei adds a line under the feet and writes DOWN.

They eat the cake. Leo talks about a story from his activity. Mei talks about a picture collection she wants to read. She wants the names and places as well as the pictures.

“You could make another label set,” Ronan says.

“I might. I also want to explain the pages myself.”

Leo nods. “Miss Wu needs people for the school materials.”

“She has helpers now,” Ronan says.

“She may have a new group next year,” Mei says. “She only mentioned a plan.”

Ronan wants to hear more. He imagines a task at the materials room desk. Perhaps he could have his name on a card there.

Mum puts another small piece of cake on his plate.

“Eat before you plan the whole school.”

He smiles and picks up his spoon.

After the visitors leave, Ronan washes the cups. Dad dries them. Mum sits down with her own book.

“Thirteen cups?” Dad asks.

“Only six.”

“A cheap birthday.”

Ronan splashes a little water toward his sleeve. Dad holds the drying cloth in front of himself like a shield.

At the shelf, Ronan puts the new birthday card beside last year's terrible tree. The tree is still funny. Dad's long toes are funnier.

His practice folder stands below them. He takes it out and writes the new date inside. He is thirteen. He still needs time for a long page. He still wants a place in the new group.

He closes the folder and brings Mum the last dry cup. She puts it beside her garden book and makes room for him on the next chair.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

accurate＝准确的；heel＝脚后跟；shield＝盾牌；mention＝提到。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan的十三岁生日怎样写出时间过去？
2. Mei想在图画之外发展什么能力？

## 读句子

**Dad / holds the card / at arm's length.** Dad／伸长手臂／拿着卡片。
